meta.title: Expert insights | Patent Insurance Strategy
meta.description: Views on patent insurance from IP lawyers and experts in Vietnam, Japan, Taiwan and China.

header.title:
5 experts
4 jurisdictions
header.lead:
Practical perspectives from lawyers,
regulators and scholars.

experts.name: Le Xuan Loc
experts.quote: There is no clear legal framework yet, and no insurer has actually launched such a product on the market.
points: A gap between policy direction and practice
Risk quantification and IP valuation models are needed
Financial institutions join only with risk-sharing mechanisms

experts.name: Nguyen Tuan Hung
experts.role: Deputy Head of Patents, Tilleke & Gibbins Vietnam
experts.quote: The crux is to determine who values intellectual assets, and by which method.
points: IP can gain value as it is used more widely
Valuation and risk sharing are preconditions
Premiums must match the buyer's expected benefit

experts.name: Kentaro Takaoka
experts.role: Deputy Director, Trade Secret/IP Management, National Center for Industrial Property Information and Training (INPIT)
experts.quote: One can say the State has built the institutional and financial foundation for IP-related insurance mechanisms.
points: Sign contracts early, with detailed risk-prevention terms
Support for IP dispute costs when firms expand abroad
Start-ups must show IP is a value-creating “weapon”

experts.name: Patent attorney (anonymous)
experts.role: Leading law firm; guides an IP professional association
experts.quote: Patent insurance is closely tied to dispute risk: whether you are sued, the outcome, the extent of liability and even attorney fees are all uncertain.
points: Buyers assess their own risk to time their purchase
Invalidity cover could shape patent transfer decisions
The US has the most developed IP-based finance market

experts.name: Assoc. Prof. Dr. Ma Biyu
experts.quote: China’s patent insurance has become a multi-layered product system covering enforcement costs, infringement liability, financial risk, professional liability and international trade risk.
points: PICC, Ping An, CPIC and Huatai are the main providers
Subsidies refund part of the premium, capped and tapering
Focus on enforcement and infringement liability cover

note: Excerpts from the research’s expert interviews, published with the experts’ consent.
